_comment: Response from GET /v1/activity/sessions/{session_id}/candidate. The extension holds this in chrome.storage.session (cleared when the browser closes), compares locally, and never sends any of it back. Prefer `hashed_fields` for anything you are not comfortable placing in a page context; the extension can compare against a hash without ever seeing the value. Hashes must be sha256 of `<session hash_salt>|<normalized value>` — request the salt at session start if you intend to precompute them, or simply supply plaintext for low-sensitivity fields only.
